note: The cut, in order. shot: a capture in out/shots, in: where to come in (seconds into the capture), dur: seconds on screen. card: an image in cards/. bed: a capture whose sound lies under a card. lead: seconds of the shot's sound to start under the beat before it. hits: moments (seconds into the beat) the score punctuates. silent: no sound at all; nosfx: the score only. gain: dB on the shot's own sound. logo: when the logo fades in (seconds into the beat).
